title: Canonical projection-normalized Roos comparison
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme W, let B be sheaves of modules over the completed integral E-coefficients. There is a natural isomorphism Q followed by the canonical right-derived inverse-limit functor on towers in B ≅ the strict Roos functor followed by Q. For every tower complex X and n≥0, the inverse comparison followed by the canonical derived projection to level n and the evaluation factorization is Q of the actual Roos projection X→X_n. The canonical inverse limit and its projections are those of [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site].

source.place: Integral operations and normalized coefficient reduction model.

proof.text: Resolve tower complexes functorially by K-injectives. The ordinary-limit inclusion into the strict Roos complex is a quasi-isomorphism on K-injectives. Invert it after localization, use the unit of the right-derived limit, and invert the resolution map to obtain the natural comparison. Its inclusion normalization proves the projection formula on K-injectives. Naturality along a K-injective resolution proves it for every tower complex.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight mapping-cone comparison lemmas, including CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso; no theorem giving this coefficient-tower derived-limit comparison with its canonical projections.
Seven comparison lemmas, including mapHomologicalComplexCompIso and its component equations; used to compare exact restriction and evaluated complexes.
Mathlib gives adjunction uniqueness; no specialized completed coefficient-system theorem. Project StrictRoosComparison supplies the derived-limit ingredient.

mathlib_searches.query: Canonical Roos complex computes right derived inverse limit of towers in an abelian category with exact countable products, with the canonical projections.
mathlib_searches.results: CategoryTheory.CountableAB4Star.of_hasExactLimitsOfShape_nat in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Abelian.GrothendieckAxioms.Basic and CategoryTheory.Functor.limitIsoOfIsRightKanExtension_inv_π in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Functor.KanExtension.Basic are general ingredients; no strict Roos comparison with the specified derived projections.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientConstantTowerRoosComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (W : Scheme.{t}) :
    ∃ e : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ coefficientConstantTowerLimit l E W ≅
        roosF ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q,
      ∀ (X : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ) (n : ℕ),
        e.inv.app X ≫ (coefficientConstantTowerProjection l E W n).app
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj X) ≫
          (coefficientConstantTowerEvaluationFactors l E W n).hom.app X =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (roosEval X n)
